import re

def parse_nginx_log_line(line: str) -> dict:
    """
    Parse a single nginx access log line into a dictionary.

    Expected format (combined log format):
    <ip> - - [<date>] "<method> <path> <protocol>" <status> <size> "<referer>" "<user_agent>"

    Returns a dict with keys: ip, date, method, path, protocol, status, size, referer, user_agent.
    """
    pattern = re.compile(
        r'^(?P<ip>\S+)'
        r' - - '
        r'\[(?P<date>[^\]]+)\]'
        r' "(?P<method>\S+)'
        r' (?P<path>[^\"]+)'
        r' (?P<protocol>[^\"]+)"'
        r' (?P<status>\d+)'
        r' (?P<size>\d+)'
        r' "(?P<referer>[^\"]*)"'
        r' "(?P<user_agent>[^\"]*)"'
    )
    match = pattern.match(line)
    if not match:
        raise ValueError(f"Could not parse nginx log line: {line}")
    return match.groupdict()
